fetch_kddcup99_load_dataset: fetch the kddcup99 anomaly detection dataset with default 10 percent subset
fetch_kddcup99_load_full_dataset: fetch the full kddcup99 dataset without the 10 percent subset
fetch_kddcup99_load_subset: fetch the kddcup99 dataset with a specific subset like SA SF http or smtp
fetch_kddcup99_return_xy: fetch the kddcup99 dataset and return X and y arrays directly
fetch_kddcup99_load_as_frame: fetch the kddcup99 dataset and return pandas DataFrames instead of ndarrays
